sources.title: Phren Craft – Celtic Modular Identity System
sources.creator: Ivana Mundja
sources.observation: Phren Craft’s consistent green gutters organize varied panels, while the emblem, serif wordmark and compact lettering establish separate levels of attention.
sources.transferablePrinciple: Carry disciplined spacing and distinct type roles into one coherent campaign composition; the crowded identity-board format is unsuitable here.
sources.doNotCopy: Ivana Mundja’s Celtic emblem, lettering, exact palette, mockup photography or panel layout.

sources.title: Cubee – Visual Identity Toolkit | Brand System
sources.creator: Dtail Branding for Dtail Studio
sources.observation: Cubee’s large stacked sans-serif statement dominates smaller aligned notes; diagonal spreads add movement, and changing line colors create emphasis.
sources.transferablePrinciple: Use a strong scale contrast and purposeful alignment, while giving every essential campaign line sufficient contrast.
sources.doNotCopy: Dtail Branding for Dtail Studio’s cube mark, repeating pattern, slogans, construction diagrams or rotated presentation layout.

sources.title: A Touch of Petal & Boldness
sources.creator: Maeve
sources.observation: Description only; artwork was not inspected. The supplied account identifies bold typography, minimalist structure and a prominent floral image in a flower-exhibition poster.
sources.transferablePrinciple: Let expressive typography and one floral focal point carry the message, with enough space to distinguish their roles.
sources.doNotCopy: Do not reconstruct an unseen layout, infer its typefaces or import its imagery and exhibition wording.

routes.name: A Gift, Held
routes.concept: The woman’s gaze and hands make the bouquet a visible gesture of care. Typography follows that attention toward the gift.
routes.brandConnection: For adults choosing a Mother’s Day gift, this connects Petal and Flowers’ personal gifting mission to a recognizable human moment. Expressive type and restrained spacing support the preferred editorial character.
routes.composition: One 1080×1350 Instagram page. Retain the original photograph as an editable photo layer with a focal cover crop protecting the face, both hands and bouquet core. Use its upper-left blue space for “Petal and Flowers” and a dominant two-line “Mother’s Day”. Place “Your first order. Her special day.” beneath the headline. Nest “50% off” and “Go now →” beside the shorter title line, within the same composition. Keep text clear of foliage and safely inset.
routes.typography: A generous, softly flared roman serif leads; a humanist sans supports. Give the occasion the largest scale, the offer the second, and supporting copy comfortable mobile readability.
routes.colorLogic: Retain photographic blue, pink and foliage green. Use deep botanical green for type on clear blue areas; require at least 4.5:1 contrast for supporting copy.
routes.originalTwist: Offset the two title lines toward the bouquet’s diagonal, making the reading direction echo the woman’s gaze and the act of holding a gift.

routes.name: Wrapped in Words
routes.concept: Turn the campaign’s typography into the wrapping around a thoughtful gift, using a single fold direction drawn from the bouquet’s tissue paper.
routes.brandConnection: The wrapping metaphor expresses the florist’s considered presentation and makes the first-order invitation feel connected to gifting. Its confident geometry accommodates the audience’s need for a quickly understood offer.
routes.composition: Keep the photograph uncropped and editable in a large landscape window within the portrait canvas. Broad, open paper bands pass behind opposite corners. The occasion follows the upper band; the first-order sentence enters the photograph’s empty blue space. Offer and action share the returning band beside the image. Preserve all five exact strings and keep the bands clear of the subject.
routes.typography: Use a bold condensed sans for the long, gently angled occasion line, with upright regular sans supporting copy. Alternate one sustained headline with short, compact reads.
routes.colorLogic: Tissue white provides the surrounding field, photographic blue anchors the image, and a restrained warm rose marks the fold. Essential text stays near-black.
routes.originalTwist: Let one change in alignment suggest the photographed tissue’s fold; the message itself becomes the gift wrap without adding ribbon illustrations or badges.

routes.name: An Enclosure for Her
routes.concept: Treat the portrait poster as an oversized flower enclosure note, with the photograph held between the words of the occasion.
routes.brandConnection: A personal note directly supports the florist’s mission of helping people show care. The quieter, spacious rhythm suits thoughtful Mother’s Day shoppers and the saved preference for warm editorial restraint.
routes.composition: Set “Mother’s” above and “Day” below a broad, uncropped landscape photo window. Their shared centered axis makes one title across the image. Keep the source photograph editable. Place the exact first-order sentence, offer and action together inside its existing left blue space, with the brand at the upper margin. The lower title word completes the enclosure rather than becoming a promotional footer.
routes.typography: Use a large, legible italic serif for the enclosing title and its upright companion for the note. A neutral sans gives the offer and action concise emphasis.
routes.colorLogic: A pale petal-pink surrounding field and deep oxblood lettering provide warmth; retain the photograph’s original blue and natural flower colors.
routes.originalTwist: The unusually generous gap between the two title words becomes a place to hold the actual gift photograph, turning typographic spacing into the enclosure.

aiDirection.selectionReason: Select “A Gift, Held”. At mobile size, the occasion and personal gesture lead, followed by the first-order message, discount and action. It makes direct use of the available photograph and suits the brand’s warm editorial voice. The landscape-to-portrait crop will lose peripheral detail; protect the face, hands and bouquet core. Use only the five required strings, retaining “50% off” as the supplied illustrative demo offer.

aiReview.summary: The portrait fulfills the brief and chosen concept with a personal photographic focus, expressive typography and an integrated offer.
strengths: The crop keeps the face, both hands and bouquet core visible, reinforcing the gesture of giving.
The offset headline and nested offer establish clear hierarchy; the occasion and discount remain prominent at thumbnail size.
All required copy is present and unclipped, with strong botanical-green contrast against clear blue space.
